name: Crawfish Étouffée
description: Crawfish tails in a smothered butter-roux sauce with onion, bell pepper and celery, served over rice.

ingredients.item: Cajun seasoning, plus more to taste
crawfish tails, thawed and drained if frozen
fresh parsley, chopped, plus more for garnish
green onion, sliced, plus more for garnish

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.text: Chop the onion, bell pepper, celery, parsley and green onion, and mince the garlic, so everything is ready before the roux starts.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.text: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook, stirring constantly, until the roux turns a caramel color.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Add the onion, bell pepper and celery and cook until tender. Add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute.

steps.title: Add the stock
steps.text: Slowly stir in the stock until the sauce is smooth. Season with the salt, black pepper and Cajun seasoning.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Bring to a boil, then reduce to medium-low, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Add the crawfish
steps.text: Stir in the crawfish tails and cook just until heated through. Stir in the parsley and green onion, saving a little of each for garnish.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon over hot rice and garnish with the reserved parsley and green onion.

notes: Thaw frozen crawfish tails completely and drain off the liquid so it doesn't thin the sauce.
Add Cajun seasoning gradually and taste before adding more.
